name: Jodlerwirt
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jodlerwirt in Eben am Achensee**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, just a stone’s throw from the sparkling **Achensee**. At **Jodlerwirt**, we invite you to experience the soulful sounds of **Jodler**—the traditional yodeling of **Tirol**—while savoring hearty mountain cuisine.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and dusted with powdered sugar, best enjoyed with a glass of fresh **Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier**. Our rustic **Hausmannskost** (homestyle dishes) includes succulent **Käsespätzle**, tender **Schweinsbraten** with **Knödel**, and slow-cooked **Wildgerichte** (game dishes) when in season.

After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the breathtaking landscapes around **Innsbruck**, **Mayrhofen**, or **Achensee**, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a **Schnaps** or a steaming **Glühwein**. Our cozy **Stüberl** (traditional tavern) is the perfect spot to unwind with locals and travelers alike, sharing stories and laughter over a **Brotzeit** (Tyrolean snack platter).

Just a short drive from **Tirol’s** capital, **Innsbruck**, **Jodlerwirt** is your gateway to the region’s rich culture, stunning nature, and unforgettable flavors. **Willkommen in Tirol!** Come as a guest, leave as family.
